questions.stem: What was the main reason for the Vishal Andhra movement?
choices: To demand a separate state for Telugu-speaking people
To oppose the formation of Andhra Pradesh
To protest against the use of English in education
To demand more power for the Maharaja of Manipur
questions.solution: The Vishal Andhra movement was primarily driven by the desire for a separate state where Telugu-speaking people could have their own administrative region. The other options do not align with the historical goals of the movement, as it was not about opposing the formation of Andhra Pradesh, protesting English in education, or seeking power for the Maharaja of Manipur.

hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the original English question and maintains the same meaning, correct answer, and validity of distractors.

hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the English original in meaning, structure, and terminology. All options are correctly translated, and the correct answer remains option (3). The distractors remain incorrect, and technical terms like 'राष्ट्र-निर्माण' (nation-building) are appropriately used.

choices: लोकशाही स्थापन करण्याचे आव्हान

questions.stem: What was the main reason the Indian government wanted to integrate the Princely States into the Indian Union?
choices: To prevent the Princely States from becoming independent nations
To ensure the unity and territorial integrity of the country
To prevent the Princely States from becoming part of Pakistan
To make the Princely States follow the same laws as the rest of India
questions.solution: The main reason the Indian government wanted to integrate the Princely States was to ensure the unity and territorial integrity of the country. This was crucial after the Partition to maintain a cohesive national identity. The other options are incorrect because they focus on specific outcomes rather than the broader goal of national cohesion, or they misrepresent the primary motivation.

hi.stem: भारतीय सरकार के लिए प्रांतीय राज्यों के भारतीय संघ में एकीकरण का मुख्य कारण क्या था?
choices: प्रांतीय राज्यों के स्वतंत्र राष्ट्र बनने से रोकने के लिए

प्रांतीय राज्यों को भारत के बाकी हिस्सों के समान कानूनों का पालन करने के लिए
hi.solution: भारतीय सरकार के लिए प्रांतीय राज्यों के भारतीय संघ में एकीकरण का मुख्य कारण देश की एकता और भू-भागीय अखंडता सुनिश्चित करना था। विभाजन के बाद राष्ट्रीय पहचान को एकजुट बनाए रखना आवश्यक था। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि वे व्यापक राष्ट्रीय एकता के लक्ष्य के बजाय विशिष्ट परिणामों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करते हैं, या वे मुख्य प्रेरणा के गलत अर्थ को दर्शाते हैं।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Hindi terminology for historical context.

mr.solution: भारतीय सरकारने प्रांतीय राज्यांना भारतीय एकीकरणात समाविष्ट करण्याचा मुख्य कारण देशाच्या एकता आणि भूमिक्षेत्रीय अखंडतेची खात्री करणे होते. विभाजनानंतर राष्ट्रीय एकता बनविण्यासाठी हे आवश्यक होते. इतर विकल्प चुकीचे आहेत कारण ते विशिष्ट निकालांवर लक्ष केंद्रित करतात आणि देशाच्या एकतेच्या मोठ्या उद्देशापेक्षा विशिष्ट निकालांवर लक्ष केंद्रित करतात, किंवा ते प्राथमिक प्रेरणाचे खरे वर्णन करत नाहीत.

distractorReason: Believes the main goal was to stop independence, not to preserve unity

questions.critique: The correct answer is 1, as the Indian government's primary motivation was to preserve national unity and territorial integrity after Partition. The other options reflect common misconceptions about the integration of Princely States.

questions.stem: Why was the North Western Frontier Province (NWFP) made to merge with Pakistan despite opposition?
choices: Because it had a Muslim majority
Because it had a Hindu majority
Because the leader opposed the two-nation theory
Because it had a Muslim minority
questions.solution: The North Western Frontier Province merged with Pakistan because it had a Muslim majority, which aligned with the principle of creating a separate state for Muslims. A Hindu majority would have made it part of India, not Pakistan. The leader's opposition to the two-nation theory does not explain the merger, and a Muslim minority would not have supported joining Pakistan.

hi.stem: उत्तर-पश्चिमी सीमा प्रांत (एनडब्ल्यूएफपी) को पाकिस्तान में शामिल करने के लिए विरोध के बावजूद क्यों किया गया?
choices: क्योंकि इसकी अधिकांश जनसंख्या मुस्लिम थी
क्योंकि इसकी अधिकांश जनसंख्या हिंदू थी
क्योंकि नेता द्वि-राष्ट्र सिद्धांत के विरोधी था

hi.critique: Translation is accurate and maintains the original meaning, with appropriate use of Hindi terminology.

mr.stem: उत्तर चौथ्या सीमा प्रांताचा (NWFP) पाकिस्तानसोबत विलीन करण्यात आला कारण विरोध होता?

questions.stem: Why did the Indian government face challenges in treating religious minorities after the Partition?
choices: Because the Constitution did not address religious rights
Because the Muslim League demanded equal treatment for Hindus
Because the population of Muslims in India was very small
Because of the legacy of the two-nation theory and communal tensions
questions.solution: The two-nation theory promoted the idea of separate nations for Hindus and Muslims, leading to deep-seated communal tensions that persisted after the Partition. These tensions made it difficult for the government to ensure fair treatment of religious minorities. The Constitution actually included provisions for religious rights, and the Muslim League did not advocate for equal treatment of Hindus. Additionally, the Muslim population in India was not small.
